resources.string: If you lose this device, it's the only way to regain control of your data on a new one. Devices you pair don't get a copy of it.
Your data is only on this device
Nothing syncs yet, so if you lose this device, your data goes with it. Set up sync to keep a copy elsewhere, and save your recovery phrase so you can get back in.
Your maps work over the network already. Download a region to make them work with no connection at all.
Tenshu Control on this device is older than your other devices, so new changes aren't arriving for any app. Your files here are safe.
You're using 80% of your free Tenshu storage.
Someone wants to share a folder with you
Compare this code with your contact in person or over a trusted channel, then confirm.
Sync activity from your paired devices will show up here.
%1$s was deleted on another device while your change was waiting
Too many tries — recovery from your phrase is the cleanest path.
Your Tenshu realm is locked. Use your device biometric to unlock.
Your Tenshu realm is locked. Enter your unlock passphrase to continue.
If you've lost access to all your devices, enter your 24-word recovery phrase below to recover your realm.
This is a slow operation by design — it takes a few seconds to derive your master key from your recovery phrase. That delay is what protects your phrase from brute-force guessing.
Don't share this phrase with anyone — including Tenshu.
Trouble recovering? See the recovery troubleshooting guide.
'%1$s' isn't a valid recovery word. Check spelling, or pick a suggestion from the autocomplete.
Recovery phrases are 24 words. You entered %1$d.
That phrase was not accepted. Check each word and try again.
This phrase doesn't look right. Double-check each word — even one wrong word breaks recovery.
Your realm is recovered. This device is now your only realm device — if you find your other devices later, you'll need to re-pair them.
You'll see your devices and apps re-appear over the next few minutes as things sync.
Tenshu is a private place for your files. Everything is encrypted on this device — nobody else can read it, including us.
I have Tenshu on another device
Your realm is ready on this device. Until you turn on sync, everything stays here — nothing leaves this device.
Tenshu secures your keys with this device's secure storage, so your files start syncing right away — even after a restart, with no passphrase to remember.
Add a passphrase for extra security
Lock Tenshu when you're not using it
Use your device biometric to lock and unlock Tenshu. Your biometric stays on this device — Tenshu never sees it.
Pick a passphrase to seal your realm on this device. You'll enter it when Tenshu locks.
Choose how to unlock Tenshu. Biometric is quickest; you'll also set a recovery passphrase as a backup.

Set an unlock passphrase. You'll use biometrics day to day — but if they ever stop working, after an app update or on a new device, this passphrase unlocks Tenshu here. It can't be reset, so pick something you'll remember. Your recovery phrase is separate: that's what restores your realm if you lose this device.
Keep this phrase secret and safe. It is the only way to recover your data if you lose access to all your devices.
This device doesn't have your recovery phrase

Only a device set up with the phrase — or one that created the realm — keeps a copy. A device added by pairing never receives it. Open this screen on a device that has it, and write the phrase down: it is the only thing that survives losing every device.
Saved. We will stop reminding you.
Remove this device from your realm and start over here.
This device leaves your realm and forgets who it was. You can set it up again later, but it joins as a new device — it will not get its name or its settings here back.
This device holds your recovery phrase. It may be the only copy. Write it down before continuing — without it nobody can add devices to this realm again.
I have saved my recovery phrase
Removing this device from your realm…
Open Tenshu on your other device

To add this device to your realm, you'll connect it with one of your existing devices. This keeps your data secure: even Tenshu can't add a device to your realm without your existing devices approving it.
1. On your existing device, open Tenshu Control.\n2. Go to Realm Devices → Add new device.
Hold the QR code from your existing device inside the box.
This pairing code requires a newer version of Tenshu. Update your app and try again.
This isn't a valid Tenshu pairing code. Scan the code shown on your other device.
This code doesn't match this hub. The pairing offer failed verification against the printed code — don't pair with it.
No pairing offer found. Arm the hub for pairing (start it while unpaired), then scan again.
Your sync relay doesn't support hub pairing yet.
Pick a name for this device. You'll see it in your realm's device list — “Sarah's MacBook”, “Living Room Hub”, anything you'll recognise.
You can rename this later in Settings → Realm Devices.
Your other device received the request. Look there for the approval prompt.
Confirm this code matches on your other device:
This device is now part of your realm. Your existing data will sync over the next few minutes.
Don't worry if sync takes a few minutes on slower connections.
This device showed a pairing code. Approve only if you're adding it yourself.
Check this code matches the one on the other device before you approve.
Check this code matches the one now shown on the new device. If it doesn't, remove that device and try again.
Verified against the printed code you scanned — no confirmation code needed. Approve only if you're setting up this hub yourself.
On the new device, scan the code shown on a device that's already signed in.
Show this on your new device
Scan this code with the device you want to add.
This device isn't recognised by your account any more — its access was removed, or the account data was reset. Pair this device again to restore it. Your local data is safe.
This realm has no storage plan, so the relay is refusing writes. Everything stays on your devices and nothing is lost — but changes won't reach your other devices until storage is set up.
Nothing will sync to it yet — this realm has no storage plan.
The new device has been paired. Your data will sync to it over the next few minutes.
On a device that already has Tenshu, open Control, choose Add a device, and scan this code — then approve the request there.
Check this code matches the one on your other device, then approve there.
The other device declined the request.
Couldn't create a pairing code. Check your connection and try again.
Sync is not yet set up. Create a realm to start syncing, or use the + button to pair into an existing realm.
Device '%1$s' wants to join your Realm.
Confirm this code matches on the other device:
If the codes don't match, don't continue — make sure both devices are on the latest version of Tenshu.
Cannot reach the sync server to check for pairing requests. This device may need to reconnect — if it persists, the relay may have restarted.
Scan this QR code from the Tenshu app on your other device.
A device wants to join — tap to review
Keeps all files on this device

Same security key as this device, under an older ID. Nothing runs as it any more, so it can never confirm it has received changes — which holds up cleaning up storage for every device. Removing it is safe unless this is a different machine restored from a backup.

“%1$s” will lose access to your files straight away, and this cannot be undone. You can set the device up again later, but it joins as a new device — it will not get its name or its settings here back.
I understand this cannot be undone
Links you've shared from your realm
Nothing stored yet. Data from your Tenshu apps will show up here.
This removes your %1$s from all your devices, and it cannot be undone. Apps that show this data will lose it too — the data belongs to you, not to any one app.
Deleted 1 item from all your devices
Deleted %1$d items from all your devices
Stopped. Some %1$s were deleted from all your devices; run it again to finish.
Could not delete your %1$s. Nothing was removed — please try again.
Links you share from Drive show up here, so you can see and revoke them.
Anyone with the link to “%1$s” will lose access. This can't be undone.
Apps you install and connect to this realm will appear here.
This version of Control does not have details for this app. It may have been added in a newer version.
Connect an app on another device
When something you tap can be shown by more than one app, Control opens the one you pick here.
Scan this code with the app on your other device. Your keys stay here — the app reaches them through this Control.
Waiting for the app to connect…
Or paste this link into the app:
Check that this code matches the one shown on your app. If they match, the app is connected.
This app is no longer installed.
Declared by the app. Tenshu does not currently restrict what an installed app can do.
This app has not declared any permissions.
Deregisters the app and forgets its permissions. To fully remove it, uninstall it from your operating system.
Not signed in on this device. To sync across devices, sign in to your Tenshu account — or create a free one.
Sign in or create an account
Synced from your account. You haven't signed in on this device yet.
Sign in on this device to change your plan, manage billing, or renew.
Your storage details aren't available yet.
This usually clears on its own. If it doesn't, Settings → Errors will say why.
Enter a redemption code to unlock storage. No email needed — codes are anonymous.
Sign in or create your free Tenshu account
A new code is on its way.

Already have a Tenshu account? Enter the same email — you'll be signed back in on this device, with your plan and storage unchanged. We use your email only to verify you're a real person and to recover your account if you lose your devices. We never see your files.
By continuing you accept our %1$s and confirm that you are 16 or older.
How we handle your data is explained in our %1$s.
We emailed a 6-digit code to %1$s. Enter it below to finish.
Enter the email for your Tenshu account. We'll send a code to confirm it's you on this device. This won't create a new account or charge you again.
To sync your data, pick a plan
Tenshu syncs your data across your devices through our relay server. We never see your files — they're encrypted on your device first.
Already have an account? Choose Free to sign in — whatever plan you're on comes back with you.
5 GB. Verify your email. Free forever.
Your subscription starts as soon as you pay, so you get access right away.
I expressly ask Tenshu to start before the withdrawal period ends. I understand that if I withdraw, I pay for the time up to my withdrawal.
Right of withdrawal and model form
Cancelling later stops future charges but does not refund the current period. Closing your account cancels immediately and forfeits the rest of the period.
Finish checkout in your browser, then come back here. This screen updates automatically once your subscription is active.
Your subscription is active on this device.
Your other devices will stop syncing. Your local data stays on this device.
One-time payment. No email collected by Tenshu — the store handles your identity.
Manage your realm devices and recovery phrase
Wi-Fi-only sync and monthly data limit
Apps backing up device data in the background
Use biometric or passphrase to unlock Tenshu
Write down your recovery phrase so you can recover this realm
Ask for your fingerprint, face, or device PIN to open Control. Your files keep syncing in the background either way.
Set up a screen lock (PIN, pattern, or biometric) in your device settings to use this.
Keep your keys encrypted until you unlock. Most secure, but background sync pauses until you next open Control.
Your recovery phrase gives full access to your data.
Forgetting this device removes its access to your account.
This removes the passphrase protecting your keys on this device.
Removing a device is permanent — it cannot rejoin under the same identity.
Confirm it's you to open Control.
Keep Tenshu running in the menu bar when you close the window
Keep Tenshu running in the notification area when you close the window
Launch Tenshu automatically when you sign in
Allow Tenshu in System Settings → Login Items
Turn Tenshu Control on in Settings → Apps → Startup
Let other apps open your Drive files
Shows Tenshu Drive when an app asks you to pick a file. Apps get only the files you choose.
Biometric unlock isn't available on this device. Tenshu will keep using your passphrase.

Use Wi-Fi only for background data
Run sync and app backups (like photos) on Wi-Fi only, never on mobile data.

This device is no longer recognised by the relay, so it can't add another device. Pair this device again, then retry.
This device can't add other devices yet. Finish setting it up first.
Deleted straight away: your Tenshu account, its email address and its sign-in sessions. Every device signed in with the account is signed out of Tenshu's storage service.
Subscriptions bought on the web or in the Google Play store are cancelled immediately, so you are not charged again. The rest of the current billing period is forfeited, not refunded.
A subscription bought through Apple's App Store can only be cancelled by you, in your Apple ID settings. Deleting your account does not cancel it.

Your synced data on Tenshu's servers is end-to-end encrypted, so Tenshu cannot read it. When you delete your account, it is scheduled for permanent deletion after a 30-day grace period; once deleted, it cannot be recovered, not even by Tenshu. If you sign in again from this device within those 30 days, your files are kept.
Kept: your invoices and the record that you accepted the terms. The law requires us to keep them for a fixed period (about 10 years). They no longer contain your email address.
Not touched: anything on your own devices, such as files you downloaded or kept offline. Removing the apps removes that.
Deleting your account is permanent and cannot be undone.
Email me a code to confirm
